intro.title: Install a Seed site on Umbrel
intro.subtitle: Self-host a Seed Hypermedia site from a community app store

beats.home: Start on your Umbrel home screen
beats.store-url: Paste the Seed app store URL
beats.wait: Umbrel pulls the images and starts the daemon and web app
beats.open-app: Umbrel shows the password — it's your registration secret
beats.site: Live on your LAN — set SEED_BASE_URL to the public URL before registering
